_comment: Per-example overrides for fingerprint tolerance and accepted-status, and the optional journal checks (lines hpo_run.log must contain; see compare_fingerprint.py). Defaults in generate_fingerprint.py: best_loss abs=1e-6 rel=1e-3; component abs=1e-6 rel=5e-3; hyperparam abs=1e-3 rel=1e-3; evals_tol=0. Override only when justified.

01_minimal.tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances, and the evaluation count exactly: the optimum is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 7), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9), and its next step, held to the box, cannot move the point, so its line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default), after 9 evaluations. No point is evaluated twice, so no decision of the search compares two relaxations of one point, which differ at the rounding level (~1e-13 relative: each PC_LAMMPS --hotvar relaxation starts from the value of the best evaluation so far).

05_extra_observables.tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances, and the evaluation count exactly: as in example 01, the optimum is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 7), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9), and its next step cannot move the point, so its line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached", after 9 evaluations. As in example 01, no point is evaluated twice, so no decision of the search compares two relaxations of one point.

06_init_random.description: INIT { STRATEGY RANDOM, SEED, INCLUDE_CONFIG false }.

09_init_warm.description: INIT { STRATEGY WARM } from a bootstrapped seed_pot.tadah.
09_init_warm.tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances, and the evaluation count exactly: the WARM start is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 1), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 2-3), and its first step cannot move the point, so its line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default), after 3 evaluations. No point is evaluated twice, so no decision of the search compares two relaxations of one point, which differ at the rounding level (~1e-13 relative: each PC_LAMMPS --hotvar relaxation starts from the value of the best evaluation so far).

12_prestage.description: STRATEGY PRESTAGE; NLOPT:GN_CRS2_LM explore + DLIB:BFGS refine.

13_restart.description: NLOPT:LN_SBPLX + RESTART decorator (stagnation-driven, seeded restart points).
status_accepted: STOPPED -- stagnation: no new best in 3 evals after 2 restart(s)
13_restart.tolerance_rationale: The run is deterministic, and every value is pinned at the default tolerances: LN_SBPLX climbs to the upper bound RCUT2B = 6 (eval 3) and stagnates there (the window of 3 evaluations without a new best fires at eval 6); RESTART relaunches it twice from RANDOM points drawn with RESTART SEED 13 + r: restart 1, from RCUT2B = 4.541125, is ended after 3 evaluations (eval 9, RCUT2B = 5.541125) while its loss still falls, none of them a new best of the run (the window counts from the run's best), and restart 2, from 5.422967, reaches the bound at eval 12 and stagnates there; the third stagnation ends the run after 15 evaluations, "STOPPED -- stagnation: no new best in 3 evals after 2 restart(s)". The bound's evaluations differ in the last digits (each PC_LAMMPS --hotvar relaxation starts from the best value so far), so the best is one of them (eval 12), the same loss and RCUT2B to the pinned digits.

15_simulated_annealing.description: TADAH:ANNEAL classic with seed-local auto-T0 calibration (post T_HOT rename).

16_fixweight_mixed.description: NLOPT:LN_BOBYQA over a flat OPTIM FIXWEIGHT(14); mixed LS-fit + pinned + OPTIM'd weights.
16_fixweight_mixed.tolerance_rationale: Weight 14 multiplies a descriptor that is zero on this dataset, so the loss does not depend on it: every evaluation ties up to ~2e-13 relative, the rounding-level noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation (exact Ecoh.in read-back), and that noise decides which evaluation is the best (any weight LN_BOBYQA probes: -22.99, eval 6, on the reference machine) and when LN_BOBYQA stops: it runs to MAXEVAL = 30 on the reference machine. That count and status are pinned; another machine's rounding can move them, and the fingerprint must then be regenerated there with that reason. The loss and components are pinned at the default tolerances; FIXWEIGHT[14] is checked only for presence: abs_tol 100 (the box width) accepts any value in its box [-50, 50]. 1.5.0's fingerprint had the start, FIXWEIGHT[14] = 0, pinned at the default tolerance.

22_pc_observable.description: PC_OBSERVABLE cohesive_energy; DLIB:BFGS with GRAD_STRATEGY resolved to ANALYTICAL; no LAMMPS.

23_per_dataset_targets.description: PC_ERMSE (1) / (2): per-dataset targets and weights over a local config.val.

24_optim_auto.description: Example 03 with OPTIM SGRIDMB (1) AUTO, which resolves to 03's box [0.1, 0.4]: same results as 03.

25_failprobe_grading.description: FAILSCORE_GRADING ON + PC_FAILPROBE over example 02's seeded search; a lattice window grades 8 failures (band A).

journal.what: all eight in band A (hot-var out of range)

26_pc_isolation.description: Example 01 with PC_ISOLATION PROCESS and PC_WORKER_TIMEOUT: 01's results in either isolation mode.
26_pc_isolation.tolerance_rationale: Example 01's search in worker processes, with 01's tolerances: best loss, components and RCUT2B at the defaults, the evaluation count exactly (9) and 01's status, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached", for the reason given in 01's tolerance_rationale.

journal.regex: PC_ISOLATION: PROCESS -- pc_lammps tasks execute in \d+ persistent worker processes

27_dm_ream_embf0.description: NLOPT:LN_SBPLX over the two negative DM_REAM embedding knots of a tadah refit seed (EMBF0 ZERO); run.sh asserts Eiso == 0 exactly for every evaluated candidate.
